fields.description: Lamaa is a four-building apartment collection beside the park at Madinat Jumeirah Living in Dubai. Arabesque exteriors surround shared podium spaces, with one- to four-bedroom plans and several large-balcony variants. This is an older launch; available resale homes and remaining developer stock must be checked separately.

overview: A large balcony can account for much of the difference between two apartment totals. The reviewed plans list suite, balcony and total separately; the selected measurements describe those specific units rather than every home in a bedroom category.
research.locationNote: Lamaa is in Madinat Jumeirah Living, Dubai, adjacent to the community park.  Views and bridge access depend on the actual building and unit.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s AED 2.3m launch headline is historical, not current stock pricing; its legacy one-bedroom table also starts near AED 1.5m. The developer page provides no usable numeric starting quote. Confirm a dated unit price rather than treating either reference as an offer.
research.paymentNote: The official original sheet specifies 20% booking, 10% March 2023, 10% September 2023, 10% June 2024 and 50% December 2025 on handover. These dates have passed and are retained as historical terms; resale balances or revised developer schedules must be checked.
research.handoverNote: The original official sheet estimated December 2025; Property Finder says January 2026 and labels the project ready/sold out. The developer page instead describes finishing and approvals, with an internal inspection at 98.01% on 11 June 2026. Current actual handover is therefore unconfirmed.
